summary: Added AccessHarvester identify-cleanup subcommand across 3 sessions. Session 1 designed the multi-signal cleanup schema (name-pattern + date-signal + cross-reference-absence), committed the JSON Schema and a 600+ line strategy document, and verified across 4 rounds. Session 2 implemented the CLI command, three detectors, ComDateMaximaProbe, output writer, and unit + [SkippableFact] integration tests; closed out across 4 verification rounds with a Session-2 R2-introduced IrLoader regression caught and fixed. Session 3 ran the pilot against HomeHealthCare (30 Low findings) and NorthwindDevEdition (41 -> 37 findings after FP fix), identified and fixed a vocabulary-regex false positive (Employee->tEmp caused by global (?i) case-folding the boundary lookarounds), added 6 regression test rows, updated the strategy doc, committed calibrated golden fixtures under cleanup/ subdirs for both DBs, and cross-provider verified VERIFIED in R1 ($0.157, gpt-5-4) with a substantive 7-point prose analysis. Full test suite green: 2127 passing, 2 skipped synthetic-fixture cases.

next_session_set.summary: Build the classify subcommand and standalone HTML editor for column data classification. harvester-object-cleanup-identifier is now a soft prereq satisfied: classify can consume the committed cleanup checklists to skip confirmed-stale tables. Completes the third arm of the three-set analytical pipeline (cleanup -> usage -> data-classification).
